notes.title: “All Scripture is God-breathed”
notes.intro: Paul says all Scripture is inspired by God and equips believers for every good work.

views.label: Scripture alone is the final authority
views.summary: Protestants see this as supporting “Scripture alone” (sola scriptura): Scripture is sufficient as the supreme rule of faith.
views.source: Westminster Confession 1.6; Formula of Concord, Rule and Norm

views.label: Scripture is inspired, and read within the Church’s Tradition
views.summary: Catholic and Orthodox Christians fully affirm Scripture’s inspiration but note the verse does not say “Scripture alone”; Scripture is interpreted within Tradition.

notes.common: All agree the Bible is inspired by God.
